## Highlights
### New
- Allow Crest on Mac to request access to system passkeys and connect to the iCloud Passwords extension
### Fixed
- Open Quick Window pages in an existing normal browser window instead of creating a duplicate - Keep password manager extensions connected while idle to avoid repeated pairing prompts - Request macOS passkey permission when you sign in on a website - Keep selected upload files accessible and explain blocked file access - Use the standard keyboard with a spacebar in the iPad command palette - Let the system handle passkey sign-in directly without an extra permission check
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.
